subject: prd/local-git-codehost
statement: FR-9 promises a base-free proof for the first mainline push, while D-2 and D-6 apply that case to a local draft lock without defining how D-4 prepares it. The existing preparation path fetches and resolves the configured mainline, rebases onto it, and loads readiness sources from it before a zero-OID landing lease can run. The local first-push hook in issue #1305/#1307 separately handles publication from the installed Pyxis init epoch. The outstanding product choice is whether drafts must wait for that bootstrap push or must gain a separate base-free draft compiler and readiness path; FR-9's first-mainline-push promise remains in either case.
